MCODE_DATA_DIR.description: Root data directory (dev default; ~/.mcode in prod)

MCODE_GIT_BRANCH.description: Dev-only branch label for hashed DB under data dir when not in a linked worktree

MCODE_GIT_TOPLEVEL.description: git rev-parse --show-toplevel; linked dev worktrees prefer <toplevel>/.mcode-local/mcode.db

MCODE_PORT.description: HTTP/WS server port (increments on collision, up to 19409 (10 attempts))

MCODE_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Empty string bypasses WebSocket auth in dev; agent:up sets a token and records it in .dev/ports.json

MCODE_SINGLE_INSTANCE.default: true in dev, false in test/prod
MCODE_SINGLE_INSTANCE.description: When true, the dev UI must present this worktree's instance token and identity

MCODE_INSTANCE_TOKEN.description: Random per-runtime token used only for dev UI pairing

MCODE_WORKTREE_IDENTITY.description: Worktree identity the UI must present when single-instance mode is on

MCODE_AGENT_RUNTIME.description: Set to 1 by agent:up so the server seeds the .dev fixture workspace

MCODE_ELECTRON_USER_DATA_DIR.description: Per-worktree Electron userData directory; agent:up sets this to .dev/electron

SKIP_ELECTRON_REBUILD.description: Set to 1 to skip Electron ABI rebuild in postinstall

NODE_ENV.description: Controls data dir suffix (.mcode-dev vs .mcode) and log verbosity

artifacts.db: Resolved like the server (worktree-local, hashed dev path, or <MCODE_DATA_DIR>/mcode.db); see bun run state:paths

singleInstance.default: enabled in development, disabled in test and production unless MCODE_SINGLE_INSTANCE overrides it
singleInstance.discovery: dev UIs fetch the paired .dev/ports.json through the dev server runtime endpoint; they do not scan localhost
singleInstance.health: GET /health does not return authToken or Set-Cookie when enabled
singleInstance.offBehavior: MCODE_SINGLE_INSTANCE=false keeps shared-server discovery and token recovery
